episodes.logline: Nora Reyes confronts her ex-fiancé at the sale of her late mother's neighborhood movie theater.
episodes.continuity_notes: First episode. Nora owns the Marlowe, a neighborhood movie theater in Portland. Her mother Rosa died after a fire blamed on her wiring. Nora has not spoken to Caleb since their engagement ended.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "My ex-fiancé bought my mortgage?"
Caleb Price lowers his umbrella. A framed photo beside him shows Nora in the same lobby, slipping a ring onto his finger.

beats.speaker: SLOAN
beats.text: "This sale pays off the loan, whoever owns it. Sign, and my crew takes the building at seven tomorrow."
Nora turns Sloan's demolition rendering upside down. In its place she sets a stack of blue movie tickets.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "My mom sold the first ticket here. She died before she could tell anyone whose fault that fire really was."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "You can take your hand off the pen, Nora."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "Last time you asked me to trust you, I paid for a wedding by myself."
Caleb sets a folded bank letter beside the sale papers. Nora jerks it out from under his hand.

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "The bank was going to foreclose Friday. I bought the loan so nobody could make you leave."

beats.speaker: SLOAN
beats.text: "He can make you stay in debt. I can get you out tonight."
An insert on the bank letter. The foreclosure date has been crossed out and initialed by Caleb.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "You could have knocked on my door. You didn't have to buy the building around me."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "I knocked. Your porch light came on and went right back out."
Sloan clicks the pen twice against the glass counter.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "Give me the pen. I'm done owing him anything."
Caleb takes an old brass key from his pocket and slides it onto the blank signature line. A red tag reads BOOTH 2.

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Your mom gave me this. She left something upstairs the fire inspectors never saw."

beats.speaker: SLOAN
beats.text: "Everything upstairs belongs to the buyer the second she signs."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Then tell her why your crew is starting with the projection booth."

episodes.logline: Nora delays the sale and follows Caleb upstairs, where an old recording implicates him in the fire.
episodes.continuity_notes: Nora has not signed. Caleb holds her mortgage and says that Rosa left evidence in Booth 2. Sloan wants the booth demolished first.

scenes.heading: INT. MARLOWE CINEMA PROJECTION BOOTH – NIGHT

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "I'm not signing. Take me to the booth."
Nora pulls the papers away from Sloan, takes the brass key and heads for the stairs.

beats.speaker: SLOAN
beats.text: "If you miss the wire window, this offer is gone. I'm not calling you in the morning."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "I think she heard you the first time."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "I don't need you to answer for me. I need you to show me where she put it."
Two sets of footsteps climb the narrow stairs. Below them, Sloan shuts her briefcase.
The key turns. Across the threshold, a paper coffee cup has a lipstick mark printed on the lid.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "She always left the last sip. Said it was for the ghost."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "I used to drink it after she left. I wanted her to think somebody believed her."
Nora lets out a laugh that stops halfway. Caleb steadies her with a hand at her waist, then lets go.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "Why did my mother give you a key she never gave me?"

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Because when she told the police the fire was set on purpose, they laughed."
He opens a metal reel tin marked TRAILERS. Inside are an audio recorder and a memory card.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "All this time I thought you walked out because I wouldn't stop defending her."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Play it. But please let it run all the way through."
Nora presses play and keeps her eyes on Caleb. He slides the memory card toward her too.
On the recorder, a fan rattles. Someone coughs close to the microphone.

beats.speaker: VICTOR
beats.text: "I paid Caleb Price to burn the Marlowe. If he wants the rest, tell him I expect a receipt."
Nora takes a step away from Caleb and reaches for the door.

episodes.logline: Caleb admits taking his father's money and asks Nora to watch footage that puts her brother at the cinema that night.
episodes.continuity_notes: A recording in Booth 2 accuses Caleb of taking money to burn the Marlowe. Nora has just reached for the door.

scenes.heading: INT. MARLOWE CINEMA PROJECTION BOOTH – NIGHT

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "I took the money. I didn't light the match."
Nora keeps the door ajar. Caleb backs away from it and puts both hands on the table.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "Who was talking on that tape? Because he said your full name like he'd used it before."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "It was my father."
Nora looks down at an engraved Price family watch around Caleb's wrist. He takes it off.

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "I took his cash straight to your mom. She told me to play along long enough to get him on tape."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "You let me believe my mom died because she was too cheap to replace the wiring."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "My father said he'd make you next. I packed a bag and called it protecting you."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "You don't get to decide what I can survive. You can sit next to me while I find out."
She slides the memory card into a laptop and angles the screen so they can both see.
Grainy footage shows the theater's rear exit just before midnight. A man in a suit steps out of a black pickup.

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "That's my dad. Look. He's got a gas can."
Nora scrubs back and freezes on the front plate, then photographs it with her phone.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "If I send this, your father is going to know it came from you."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Put my name on it."
The footage resumes. A second figure steps into the headlights and hands Victor a key.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "That's Miles. That's my brother letting him in."
The real booth door scrapes along the floor behind them.

beats.speaker: MILES
beats.text: "Before you send that, ask him which one of us called the fire department."

episodes.logline: Miles confesses his part in the fire, then Nora receives a call that challenges everything she knows about her mother's death.
episodes.continuity_notes: Nora saw footage of her brother Miles letting Caleb's father into the Marlowe with a gas can. Miles appeared in the booth and told her to ask who called the fire department.

scenes.heading: INT. MARLOWE CINEMA PROJECTION BOOTH – NIGHT

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "You called. Then you ran."

beats.speaker: MILES
beats.text: "I let him in to take the inspection records, Nora. Nobody said there was going to be a fire."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "He carried a gas can right past you. You handed him the key."
Miles raises his burned left hand, then lowers it. Nora sees it and looks back at the laptop.

beats.speaker: MILES
beats.text: "I told dispatch Mom was inside. Victor grabbed the phone and said there wasn't anybody in the building."

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "There was a closed casket. They told me there was no point in looking."
Caleb's phone begins to vibrate on the table.
The screen lights up with one word: DAD.

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "That's the first time he's called since I bought your loan."
Caleb turns the phone toward Nora and waits for her to reach for it.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "Last time I heard his voice, he was asking if I wanted roses for the funeral."

beats.speaker: CALEB
beats.text: "Take my hand if you want to. I'll stay either way."
She grips his hand, backs up the footage to her email and accepts the call on speaker.

beats.speaker: VICTOR
beats.text: "Nora, there's a car outside. Bring me the memory card and I'll take you to your mother."
Through the booth window, headlights sweep the cinema entrance. A black pickup idles at the curb.

beats.speaker: NORA
beats.text: "I buried my mother. You stood next to me while I did it."
The pickup's passenger window lowers. There is a rustle close to Victor's microphone.

beats.speaker: ROSA
beats.text: "Nora, honey. Leave the card where it is. And don't let Caleb look out that window."
Nora lunges for Caleb as he reaches for the blind.
